Home / Components / Alert

Alert Components

Accent Outline Alerts

Standard alerts with left-accent borders. Click the close button to dismiss.

check_circle Success Alert: Information saved correctly.
error Danger Alert: Something went wrong.
warning Warning Alert: Disk capacity is almost full.
Full Background Alerts

Banners with solid theme backgrounds and matching text contrasts.

info Primary Info: New system updates are available.
check_circle Success Status: All attendance records synced!
error Critical Error: Database credentials incorrect.
Neo-Brutalist Shadow Banners

Banners utilizing the `.alert-shadow` utility class for signature hard offset border shadows.

warning Shadow Warning: Unsaved changes will be lost.
info Shadow Banner: System dispatch queue is now empty.
Countdown Progress Alerts

Alerts with countdown progress timers animating at the bottom. Auto-close behaviors can be attached.

hourglass_empty Auto Closing: Session expires in 5 seconds.
error Emergency Stop: Server restarting in 8 seconds.
